settings.question: I just spilled liquid on my MacBook. What should I do right now?
settings.answer: Switch it off immediately by holding the power button, unplug the charger and all cables, wipe away surface liquid, and leave the lid slightly open. Do not put it in rice, do not use a hairdryer, and do not plug it back in to test it. Rice leaves starch dust inside the chassis and heat melts keyboard membranes while power accelerates corrosion on wet circuits.

settings.question: It still works after the spill. Do I still need it checked?
settings.answer: Yes. Liquid leaves conductive mineral residue under chips and connectors that slowly corrodes fine copper traces over days or weeks. Catching a wet board early usually keeps the repair simpler and protects parts like the keyboard, trackpad, and display connector from failing later.

settings.question: Will my data be safe?
settings.answer: Original SSD kept. Data is prioritised and there is no routine wipe, because we repair your original logic board rather than swapping it for a blank board. Liquid damage can still affect storage circuits directly, so while we take every care to preserve your data, no workshop can guarantee storage survival before opening the board.

settings.question: How much does it cost, and what does the £49 cover?
settings.answer: The £49 diagnostic covers insured UK courier collection and return, opening the MacBook before any power is applied, disconnecting the battery, inspecting both sides of the logic board under the microscope and thermal camera, and sending you a written report with a fixed repair quote. Board repairs start from £249 and the £49 diagnostic is credited in full if you go ahead. Unlike an Apple Tier 4 full-device replacement quote, you only pay to repair the damaged circuits.

settings.question: What if I do not go ahead, or it cannot be repaired?
settings.answer: If you decline the repair quote after the diagnostic, or if the board is beyond economical repair, the £49 diagnostic fee covers the bench inspection and we return your MacBook by insured courier at no extra cost.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Our Fitzrovia workshop is open Mon to Fri 9am to 6pm, Sat & Sun Closed. Once your MacBook arrives, you receive your written diagnostic report and fixed quote within 1 working day. Once you approve the quote, most liquid damage board repairs are completed and tested within 2 working days.

settings.question: What does the 2-year warranty cover, and what does it not?
settings.answer: Our 2-year warranty covers the circuits we repaired, the components we replaced, and our Fitzrovia micro-soldering workmanship. It does not cover new liquid, drop, or physical impact damage, and it does not cover a different circuit failing later from the same spill.

settings.question: How does collection work?
settings.answer: Collection and return are included with your £49 diagnostic at any order value. In selected London zones we arrange same-day courier collection. Anywhere else in the UK we send a tracked, insured mail-in pack straight to your address.
